_comment: The structure of the registry. You do not normally write this manually. Use `warden add-mcp`, `add-skill`, or `migrate`, or the `admin` MCP tool. Writes go to $WARDEN_CONFIG, $WARDEN_HOME/config.json, or ~/.config/warden/config.json. Writes do not go to the current directory. warden ignores an unknown key like this one.
